title: Funiculì, Funiculà
attribution: Music by Luigi Denza (1846-1922), Neapolitan words by Peppino Turco (1846-1903), written in 1880 for the opening of the Vesuvius funicular; both authors died more than 70 years ago, public domain. Written in 6/8 with the eighth note as the beat (dotted quarter = 3 beats), so the tempo is in eighths (about 100 dotted quarters per minute).
